entities.name: Milton C. Garber
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milton Cline Garber was a U.S. representative from Oklahoma. He also served as an associate justice of the Oklahoma Territory before Oklahoma became a state. In 1942, he was inducted into the Oklahoma Hall of Fame.
